prompt: The client wants to speed up truck unloading across its warehouses. Which takeaway matters most?

exhibit.title: Average time to unload a truck (minutes)

options.text: Warehouse D is the fastest, at 38 minutes
options.feedback: True, but D is only a few minutes faster than A, B and E. C is the outlier.

options.text: C unloads about as fast as the others
options.feedback: C takes 85 minutes; the rest take 38–42.

options.text: C takes twice as long as the others
options.feedback: Right. C averages 85 minutes; A, B, D and E average 38–42.
The chart shows times, not equipment. That may be true, but nothing here supports it.
